items.colloc: make a payment 付款 | defer payment 延期付款
items.distinct: pay 薪資 | price 價格
ex: We require full payment prior to shipment.
我們要求在發貨前付清全款。
She received confirmation of her online payment.
她收到了線上付款的確認通知。
Clients can choose from several payment methods.
客戶可以從幾種付款方式中做選擇。

items.colloc: gift voucher 禮券 | redeem a voucher 兌換代金券
items.distinct: coupon 折價券 | ticket 票卷
ex: The company issued a travel voucher to employees.
公司向員工發放了旅遊抵用券。
You can redeem this voucher at any branch.
您可以在任何分店兌換此代金券。
Keep the expense voucher for tax auditing purposes.
保留費用憑證以便做稅務審計。

items.colloc: billing cycle 帳單週期 | billing address 帳單地址
items.distinct: charging 收費 | pricing 定價
ex: Please update your current billing address online.
請在網路上更新您目前的帳單地址。
The accounting department is responsible for monthly billing.
會計部門負責每月的開立帳單作業。
An error occurred during the automatic billing process.
自動請款過程中發生了錯誤。

items.colloc: bank statement 銀行對帳單 | financial statement 財務報表
items.distinct: declaration 申報書 | summary 摘要
ex: Check your monthly bank statement for unauthorized fees.
檢查您的每月銀行對帳單有無未授權費用。
The supplier sends a statement of account every month.
供應商每個月都會寄送對帳單。
Review the financial statement before making investments.
在進行投資之前，請先審閱財務報表。

items.colloc: due date 到期日 | balance due 應付餘額
items.distinct: expired 過期的 | pending 待處理的
ex: The total payment is due within thirty days.
全額款項須於三十天內付清。
Please settle the balance due by next Friday.
請在下週五前結清應付餘額。
Our electricity bill is due at the end.
我們的電費帳單會在月底到期。

items.colloc: monthly instalment 每期付款 | pay in instalments 分期付款
items.distinct: down payment 頭期款 | lump sum 一次付清
ex: Customers may pay for goods in monthly instalments.
顧客可以分期付款購買商品。
The final instalment must be paid next month.
最後一期款項必須在下個月付清。
They offers zero-interest instalments for new members.
他們為新會員提供零利率分期付款。

items.colloc: settle an account 結帳 | settle a bill 支付帳單
items.distinct: clear 結算 cleared | adjust 調整
ex: He promised to settle the debt very soon.
他承諾會很快清償這筆債務。
We should settle the outstanding account today.
我們今天應該結清這筆未付帳款。
The buyer agreed to settle the bill immediately.
買方同意立即支付該帳單。

items.colloc: in arrears 拖欠中 | mortgage arrears 房貸欠款
items.distinct: debt 債務 | default 違約
ex: The tenant was three months in arrears with rent.
該房客已積欠了三個月的租金。
We must collect all unpaid arrears this week.
我們本週必須收回所有未付的欠款。
The company cleared its arrears before launching products.
該公司在推出新產品前清償了欠款。

items.pos: v. 電匯 | n. 電線
items.colloc: wire transfer 電匯 | wire money 匯款
items.distinct: cable 纜線 | transfer 轉帳
ex: Please wire the funds directly to our account.
請直接將資金電匯至我們的帳戶。
They wired the payment to the supplier yesterday.
他們昨天已經把貨款電匯給供應商了。
A small transaction fee applies when you wire.
當您電匯時會收取少許的手續費。

items.pos: n. 信用；賒帳 | v. 存入
items.colloc: credit limit 信用額度 | credit note 折讓單
items.distinct: debit 扣款 | balance 餘額
ex: The bank extended her credit limit significantly today.
銀行今天大幅大幅提高了她的信用額度。
We will credit the refund to your account.
我們將把退款存入您的帳戶中。
Purchases can be made on credit upon approval.
經核准後，採購可以採取賒帳方式。

items.pos: n. 扣款；借記 | v. 扣帳
items.colloc: debit card 簽帳卡 | direct debit 自動扣繳
items.distinct: credit 貸項 | deposit 存款
ex: The payment was debited from my checking account.
這筆付款已從我的支票帳戶中扣除。
Set up a direct debit to pay bills.
設定自動扣繳來支付每月的帳單。
Check the debit column on your balance sheet.
請檢查您資產負債表上的借方欄位。

items.colloc: reconcile accounts 核對帳目 | reconcile figures 比對數據
items.distinct: match 符合 | balance 平衡
ex: The accountant must reconcile the bank statements monthly.
會計師每月必須核對銀行對帳單。
It took hours to reconcile the discrepancy between accounts.
花了數小時才調和帳戶間的不符之處。
Please reconcile these invoices with our purchase orders.
請將這些發票與我們的採購單進行對帳。

items.colloc: itemized bill 明細帳單 | itemized receipt 費用明細表
items.distinct: detailed 詳細的 | listed 列出的
ex: Request an itemized receipt for tax deduction claims.
索取一份明細收據以用於申報報稅扣除。
The vendor provided an itemized list of expenses.
廠商提供了一份分項列出費用的清單。
Please review the itemized invoice for any errors.
請審閱這份明細發票看是否有誤。

items.pos: n. 附加費 | v. 加收費用
items.colloc: fuel surcharge 燃油附加費 | service surcharge 服務附加費
items.distinct: fee 費用 | tax 稅金
ex: A credit card surcharge will be added total.
總金額將會加收信用卡附加手續費。
Airlines increased their fuel surcharge this month significantly.
航空公司本月大幅調高了燃油附加費。
Avoid extra surcharges by paying the bill early.
提早支付帳單以避免額外的附加費用。

items.colloc: discrepancy in figures 數據不符 | resolve a discrepancy 解決差異
items.distinct: error 錯誤 | difference 差別
ex: We noticed a discrepancy between invoice and shipment.
我們注意到發票與出貨數量之間有不符。
The audit revealed a minor discrepancy in records.
審計顯示記錄中有微小的數據出入。
Please clarify the discrepancy before approving the payment.
在核准付款前請先澄清此不符之處。

items.colloc: proof of payment 付款證明 | proof of purchase 購買證明
items.distinct: evidence 證據 | certificate 證書
ex: Keep this receipt as proof of purchase always.
請始終保留這張收據作為購買證明。
The customer provided proof of electronic transfer today.
客戶今天提供了電子轉帳的證明。
We need valid proof of identity for refund.
辦理退款時我們需要有效的身分證明。

items.colloc: prepayment penalty 提前還款罰金 | require prepayment 要求預付
items.distinct: deposit 訂金 | advance 預支
ex: The vendor requires a thirty percent prepayment upfront.
廠商要求預先支付百分之三十的預付款。
There is no penalty for early prepayment option.
選擇提前還款並不會產生任何罰金。
Confirm whether prepayment is refundable under these conditions.
請確認在這些條件下預付款是否可退。

items.colloc: include gratuity 包含小費 | discretionary gratuity 隨意給的小費
items.distinct: tip 小費 | bonus 紅利
ex: A ten percent gratuity is included bill.
帳單中已包含百分之十的服務費。
Gratuity is optional for exceptional customer service.
對於優良的客戶服務，小費是隨意的。
The total price includes tax and customary gratuity.
總價已包含稅金以及慣例的服務費。

items.pos: adj. 可徵稅的；應納稅的
items.colloc: taxable income 應稅所得 | taxable goods 應稅商品
items.distinct: taxing 繁重的；徵稅的 | tax-exempt 免稅的
ex: Most of your income is considered taxable.
你大部分的收入都被視為應稅所得。
The company calculated all taxable transactions.
公司計算了所有應納稅的交易。
Identify which items are taxable for the report.
請確認報表中哪些項目需要課稅。

items.colloc: result in nonpayment 導致未付款 | penalty for nonpayment 未付款罰則
items.distinct: underpayment 付款不足 | default 違約
ex: Legal action was taken due to nonpayment.
由於未付款，公司採取了法律行動。
The service will be suspended after nonpayment.
若未付款，該服務將被暫停。
They sent a warning regarding late nonpayment.
他們發出了一份關於逾期未付款的警告。
